title: Thread the env-var inputs through Options so the 20 serial tests can parallelise
body:
Twenty tests stay serial after tick x73 (16 in subprocess, 4 in herdr) because TICFAC_TRANSCRIPT_HOME, TICFAC_HARNESS_DIR and TICFAC_STEER_SOCK_DIR reach the code under test through os.Getenv and t.Setenv refuses a parallel test. Threading each through the executor's Options (the way Options.Procs and Options.Now already thread the process table and the clock) would let them join the parallel pack and cut subprocess's ~15s serial floor and herdr's 1.55s to near zero. A production-code change, so deliberately outside x73; the `serial:` lines name each reason.
evidence: internal/exec/subprocess/activity.go:278 (transcriptHome), internal/exec/subprocess/executor.go:712 (harnessDir), internal/exec/subprocess/workerconfig.go:48 (steerSockPath); the 20 `serial:` doc lines added by tick x73
